test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that rectifies the spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.

He felt __priviledged__ to have received the country’s greatest honour.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **privileged **.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"priviledged"** is incorrect and needs to be rectified. The correct spelling is **"privileged"**. (विशेष अधिकार प्राप्त)
